content: {"like":["Values authenticity and detail in performances, especially in musical and historical contexts; appreciates well-crafted, entertaining content that encourages repeated viewings and fan discussion; enjoys high production quality and thoughtful behind‑the‑scenes material; favors shows that blend nostalgia with creative originality; prefers works that respect the source material while offering fresh, engaging storytelling."],"dislike":["Dislikes perceived inauthentic or overly comedic portrayals that undermine the original spirit; is critical of productions that sacrifice musical quality for live acting; finds fault with shows that rely on gimmicks or unresolved plotlines; rejects forced political commentary or biased edits; is wary of low production values and poor technical execution that detract from the viewing experience."]}
